authority: Immutable original approved 30-item professional roadmap acceptance contract. Implementation may evolve; clauses may not silently disappear. Any reduction requires explicit user-approved amendment.

items.name: Live News Intelligence upgrade
original_acceptance: Near-real-time/event-aware ingestion where providers permit it
Dedupe/materiality/ticker-sector mapping
Propagate to Catalyst Watch, Trade Readiness, Decision Queue, Research and relevant desks
Explicit source/timestamps; AI may summarize but not replace evidence

items.name: Macro Intelligence v2
original_acceptance: Release-aware CPI/Core CPI/PPI/NFP/jobs/unemployment/GDP/retail/ISM/Fed and other key releases
Track actual/forecast/previous/surprise
Track subsequent market reaction

items.name: Economic Calendar
original_acceptance: Canonical economic-event calendar
Sortable/filterable by High/Medium/Low impact
Filter by date
Filter by country/region
Filter by category
Preserve actual/forecast/previous/surprise/source truth
High-impact events feed Market/Desk Readiness and preparation jobs

items.name: FOMC / Fed Event Intelligence
original_acceptance: Upcoming FOMC meeting/decision, statement and press-conference countdown plus relevant Fed events
Integrate Dashboard context, Pre-Market/Open Prep and Trade Readiness without a separate major tab

items.name: Market Sentiment Composite
original_acceptance: Transparent DE.PULSE composite when no licensed third-party index
Inputs may include VIX, breadth, momentum, credit/risk and safe-haven behavior
Context only; missing evidence degrades confidence

items.name: Market / Sector Heat Map
original_acceptance: Heat map for S&P 500, sectors and watchlist where feasible
Reuse existing quote universe
Complement Market Regime and sector intelligence; no competing signal
Explicit freshness/coverage/missing truth

items.name: Deterministic Market-Structure State
original_acceptance: Canonical structure taxonomy per ticker/horizon
Same state across Dashboard/Research/desks
Does not replace deterministic score/action

items.name: SPY / QQQ Seasonality Intelligence
original_acceptance: 10-year monthly/seasonal context
Average, median, positive-period win rate, best/worst, sample size and current-year comparison
Context only; small samples not predictive

items.name: Gamma Exposure / GEX Intelligence
original_acceptance: Options Intelligence only when chain/OI quality sufficient
Gamma flip, zones and major strikes with clear methodology
No false precision or dealer-positioning claim
Context only; no options desk/execution

items.name: Social & Community Intelligence pipeline
original_acceptance: Normalize permitted/user-authorized X, Reddit, Telegram, Discord and WhatsApp inputs where supported
Official APIs/bots/connectors only; no scraping/bypass
Separate from verified news
Dedupe/ticker-map/credibility-source label
Always untrusted; prompt-injection defense

items.name: Oil / Energy Context
original_acceptance: WTI/CL and Brent/BZ contextual feeds
Trend/change/spread context
Truthful continuous-contract/roll/delay semantics
Context only; no futures execution

items.name: Market Tradeability / Sit on Hands
original_acceptance: Deterministic market-level state
Combine Regime, VIX, breadth, macro/event risk, liquidity/spreads, freshness, setup availability, extension and valid options context
Feed Dashboard, Prep, Decision Queue and desks
Not AI-generated and does not mutate deterministic desk scores

items.name: Market Breadth & Internals
original_acceptance: Advancers/decliners and participation
Percent above key moving averages
New highs/lows
Sector participation where reliable
Material input to Market Regime and Tradeability
Coverage/freshness/source limitations explicit

items.name: Relative Strength / Weakness Engine
original_acceptance: Ticker performance versus SPY, QQQ, sector and where feasible industry
Day and Swing horizons
Feed ranking, Research and Trade Readiness
Canonical owner; no deterministic score mutation

items.name: Sector & Industry Regime Intelligence
original_acceptance: Sector trend and breadth
Leadership/lagging and relative strength
Correlate each ticker with sector/industry context
Canonical owner; explicit evidence coverage

items.name: Data Conflict / Provenance Reconciliation
original_acceptance: Record provider conflicts, authoritative winner and reason
Surface material conflicts in Data Engine/Freshness
AI receives reconciled evidence plus unresolved conflicts

items.name: Corporate Actions & Symbol Lifecycle hardening
original_acceptance: Splits/reverse splits/dividends where relevant/ticker changes/mergers/delistings/IPOs/stale-symbol handling
Protect history/technical calculations from silent distortion

items.name: Signal Outcome Measurement
original_acceptance: Measure entry-zone touch, MFE, MAE, invalidation, target achievement and elapsed time
Freeze evidence snapshot by horizon
No Journal/Portfolio resurrection

items.name: Signal Calibration & Professional Validation
original_acceptance: Compare measured setup combinations/states
Analytics first
Never auto-rewrite deterministic formulas; changes require explicit versioned approval

items.name: Market Replay / Historical Scenario Validation
original_acceptance: Replay historical evidence through deterministic engines
Reusable known scenarios including CPI/FOMC shocks, earnings gaps, high-VIX sessions and other known sessions
No lookahead; validation tool not mock-live mode

items.name: Smart Notifications
original_acceptance: Meaningful state changes only
Material news, insider purchase, readiness change, Entry Zone reached/lost, catalyst trigger, Tradeability deterioration and data degradation
No noisy standalone Alerts workspace by default

items.name: AI Evidence Architecture v2
original_acceptance: Decision Brief/What Changed/Earnings/SEC-insider/Catalyst/Risk/technical/market-sector/Tradeability/macro/options/freshness provenance
Bull/Base/Bear, contradictions, missing evidence and invalidators

items.name: AI safety against bad external content
original_acceptance: Treat news/filings/social text as untrusted data
External content cannot override application/system rules
Require evidence/source IDs; stale/partial critical evidence degrades readiness

items.name: AI model routing / cost control
original_acceptance: Fast/low-cost models for simple work and stronger models for deep review
Cache by evidence snapshot
Do not rerun on trivial quote ticks; refresh on material evidence changes

items.name: Research Package Freshness correction
original_acceptance: Page-level freshness represents the whole research evidence package
Dataset freshness remains visible inside sections

items.name: Correlation / Concentration Awareness
original_acceptance: Warn when active candidates/watchlists represent same factor/sector trade
Context/readiness only; do not restore Portfolio

items.name: Liquidity & Slippage Intelligence
original_acceptance: Spread percent and relative-to-normal spread
Dollar volume
Opening liquidity
Volatility-adjusted slippage risk
Especially feeds Day Trade readiness

items.name: Reaction Intelligence
original_acceptance: Extend reactions across earnings, SEC, CPI/FOMC and material news
Immediate and 5/15/30/60-minute reaction
Volume/RVOL, VWAP hold/fade, opening-range behavior, absorption/rejection

items.name: Event-to-Decision Correlation
original_acceptance: Correlate events through existing decision architecture
May change Tradeability/Readiness/Decision Queue
No isolated extra deterministic score

items.name: Extreme Production validation
original_acceptance: Every new capability extends existing extreme/adversarial coverage
Failures/stale timestamps/duplicates/DST/provider conflicts/AI stale context/cross-module/deterministic regressions
No false Fresh/Ready/provider/source/classification and no lost canonical state
